event.description: Remove fixed-layout delimiter and unused padding token
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 3,424 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0005, which introduced interleaved LSB-first operand pairs and removed the plus token at 5,792 parameters and 99.93% official accuracy; there is no failed in-family result. Hypothesis: absolute positions already mark the fixed input/output boundary, so the equals delimiter and wholly unused PAD vocabulary vector add no necessary representational information; removing both saves two tied vocabulary vectors and one position row, yielding 3,376 parameters. This combines delimiter removal (representational change) with unused-vector compression. It is more informative than the nearest untested PAD-only deletion because it tests whether the fixed boundary is implicit while still preserving BOS/EOS and generic greedy decoding. Feed-forward width remains at the accepted boundary 7.
